reserveReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 backing review
reserveReview.rationale: dForce describes USX as overcollateralized by crypto assets and as supporting 1:1 minting and redemption with USDT, USDC, and DAI. The reviewed issuer documentation does not publish a current asset allocation, collateral balances, named custody providers, or liability reconciliation, so the complete envelope is represented as one mixed pool rather than an unsupported split.
